title: WaterSound Crossings C-105 "Shore Thing" - 100 S Bridge Lane
h1: WaterSound Crossings C-105 "Shore Thing" - 100 S Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Great views of the Gulf and natural sand dunes- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and beach are just yards away- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Free Wi-Fi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*The property does not come with dedicated parking spaces, however 2 vehicles can enter the community for the opportunity to park in the first come first serve parking. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through February 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: Beautiful gulf views await in this Crossing condo located in beautiful WaterSound. Conveniently loacted between the Crossings Pool and the beach, this unit is perfect for relaxing in the sun. As soon as you walk in, you will swept away by the gorgeous dune views of the Gulf of Mexico. The emerald waters and sparkling sand lend for the perfect backdrop for this beautiful unit. The open living area is filled with windows to take in the views and offers seating for everyone whether dining, watching television, or simply taking in the views.The kitchen area offers gourmet amenities with rich hardwood cabinetry, granite countertops, and professional stainless steel appliances. Enjoy having all of the amenities of home as you prepare meals in this beautiful kitchen. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with picture perfect views, flat screen television with DVD, and a king bed for relaxing. Access to the porches, make this room the perfect getaway. The primary bath brings a perfect touch of pampering to your vacation with an over-sized jetted tub and a large walk-in shower. The second bedroom is a queen room featuring porch access, flat screen television/DVD, and a private bath with a shower and a single vanity. The third bedroom has a twin over twin bunk bed, a flat screen television/DVD, and a private bath.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8) FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Tub/Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower- Guest Bedroom: Twin over Twin Bunk, Private Bathroom With Shower- Living Area: Sleeper Sofa*Per the HOA Policies: Nothing to be draped on railings. Balconies to be kept neat and clean. No grills (gas, charcoal, electric or similar apparatus) are allowed on balconies, under any overhang or within 20ft of any structure per the FL Fire Prevention Code, NFPA 1 chapter 10.11.6.1. The Water Sound Rules and Regs further specify that only the grills provided in the pool enclosure are allowed on property.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
